description: Singular anomaly is a solo Python data script pipeline navigating the Interplanetary Survival Guide Martian Map track at the Surat hub. Led by a first-semester B.Tech Computer Science student specializing in Data Science and Machine Learning, the project uses Python data tools alongside AI assistance to process raw multi-mission planetary telemetry files, clean grid coordinate anomalies, and plot layered visual pathfinding maps to guide human astronauts safely across the Martian surface.
summary: Global orbital maps show where Mars is; ARES-NAV shows a human explorer where their next footstep should go. Developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 under the "Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map" challenge, ARES-NAV is an operational Extravehicular Activity (EVA) mission planning platform engineered for human exploration of Jezero Crater. Rather than presenting static imagery, the platform synthesizes real planetary datasets from five NASA missions into an interactive decision-support system. ARES-NAV integrates MGS MOLA digital elevation models, MRO HiRISE optical mosaics, MRO CRISM mineralogical detections, Mars Odyssey THEMIS thermal inertia, and Mars 2020 Perseverance MEDA weather and RAD radiation measurements. At its core, an energetic slope-penalized A* pathfinding algorithm automatically routes astronauts around high-sinkage sand dunes, boulder ejecta, and cliff scarps while monitoring real-time metabolic oxygen expenditure and life-support margins. The platform provides an edge-to-edge 3D terrain canvas, an authentic NASA GIS layer stack, and an interactive 3D Mars globe featuring historical exploration sites.
details:
### What Does It Do & How Does It Work?

ARES-NAV is an astronaut-centric tactical navigation and life-support planning system designed for human extravehicular activity (EVA) in Jezero Crater, Mars.

Current planetary GIS tools (such as NASA Trek or JMARS) serve orbital scientists by rendering static 2D rasters, but human explorers require real-time tactical situational awareness: safe traversability, metabolic energy costs, life-support reserves, and scientific prioritization.

ARES-NAV operates in three integrated operational modes:

1. 3D Surface Tactical Canyon View: A full-bleed WebGL 3D terrain canvas allowing first-person astronaut visor POV navigation, dynamic dust storm simulation, elevation profiling, and interactive waypoint inspection.

2. NASA Mars Trek GIS Reconnaissance Mode: An authentic multi-layer GIS mapping interface powered by NASA JPL tile services, featuring toggleable MOLA elevation, Viking MDIM2.1 imagery, CRISM mineralogy overlays, slope gradient contours, and Perseverance rover traverse tracks.

3. Mars Digital Twin (3D Global Explorer): A 3D interactive globe with procedural albedo provinces, Valles Marineris and Olympus Mons formations, polar ice caps, and clickable radar pins for 18+ historical rovers and landers opening comprehensive Wikipedia-style scientific dossiers.

### Core Algorithmic & Scientific Engines:

- Slope-Penalized Multi-Algorithm Traversal: ARES-NAV benchmarks 5 pathfinding algorithms (A* Safety-Aware, Dijkstra, Greedy Best-First, Bidirectional A*, and Direct Line). The A* algorithm penalizes steep terrain slopes (>15° rover/suit rollover limits), sand dune slip hazards in the Séítah formation, and boulder fields.

- Biophysical Life-Support Simulation: Dynamically models astronaut metabolic rate (W), oxygen consumption (L/min) based on terrain gradient, battery drain (Wh), suit thermal regulation, and solar cosmic radiation exposure against Perseverance RAD Sol 1328 baselines (0.62 mSv/day).

- CRISM Astrobiological Target Scoring: Evaluates candidate sample extraction sites based on mineralogical biosignature preservation potential (smectite clays, magnesium carbonates, and hydrated silica).

- AI Mission Intelligence: An integrated Gemini 1.5 Flash tactical advisor providing military-brevity telemetry analysis, abort calculations, and hazard advisories.

### Technologies, Tools & Languages:

- Frontend & Visualization: React 19, Vite, Three.js, React Three Fiber, React Three Drei, Leaflet, React-Leaflet, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons.

- Geospatial Pipeline & Calculations: Custom mathematical geodesy (Mars reference datum, Vincenty geodetic distance formula, DEM gradient extraction, Min-Heap priority queues for pathfinding).

- Validation & Quality Assurance: 70/70 automated test suite verifying terrain classifications, metabolic models, heuristic admissibility, and NASA PDS citation endpoints.

- Repository & Hosting: Open-source on GitHub (https://github.com/shaswat2406/ares-nav) with continuous CI/CD deployment on Netlify.

### Creativity & Innovation:

Unlike conventional static dashboards, ARES-NAV was designed from an astronaut's operational perspective. By coupling orbital remote-sensing data with physiological metabolic load and terrain mechanics, it answers the fundamental operational question of human planetary exploration: Can the astronaut make it to the science target and return safely to the habitat before life-support reserves drop below 25%?
